homeExp.title: Endless experience options
homeExp.subtitle: Slovenia offers everything from Alpine peaks to the Adriatic coast — in an area smaller than Wales.
homeExp.hikingDesc: Triglav, Mangart, Storžič — from gentle strolls to demanding ascents.
homeExp.waterDesc: Rafting on the Soča, kayaking on the Kolpa, water skiing in Portorož.
homeExp.historyDesc: Medieval castles, Predjama, Ljubljana Castle, Soča Front museums.
homeExp.natureDesc: Triglav National Park, Lake Cerknica, Slovenia's forests.
homeExp.foodDesc: From kremšnita to štruklji, from Teran to rebula — 24 gastronomic regions.
homeExp.gemsDesc: Vintgar Gorge, the Sečovlje salt pans, Logar Valley — off the beaten path.
